name: toggle
need: Turn an option on or off with a button, or pick one or several in a set of toggle buttons

--ds-toggle-group-gap.description: toggle group: the gap between its toggles at the comfortable density (2px less per density step)

labExempt.DS.toggle.create: state only: the button's fill fades on its own transition (Button), nothing else moves
labExempt.DS.toggle.group: state only: the buttons' fills fade on their own transitions, nothing else moves
labExempt.DS.toggle.nextPressed: a pure function of the state
labExempt.DS.toggle.parseValue: a pure function of the state
